experiments.input_specification: Six producer variants using each producer's own pinned families, HELP/TYPE and labels: vLLM iteration_tokens_total histogram, SGLang latency, Dynamo frontend/backend views, TGI batch size, Triton shared pinned pool and TensorRT block/iteration gauges.
experiments.limits_of_claim: Pinned names are documentation evidence, not running release compatibility; per-family mappings remain distinct.
experiments.negative_expected_result: Malformed types fail explicitly; absent optional statistics remain unavailable, not zero; no snapshot becomes raw events.
experiments.positive_expected_result: Preserve native name, type, unit, labels and producer scope; a _total suffix does not override a histogram TYPE; Triton shared pool remains server-wide.
experiments.purpose: Specify and later evaluate: Native families and producer boundaries
experiments.title: Native families and producer boundaries

experiments.input_specification: Synthetic Triton success counter 100 at virtual t=0 seconds, 150 at t=10; a reset variant; separately preserve raw TGI request_count.
experiments.limits_of_claim: Invented counter values do not resolve actual API admission semantics or prove complete terminal populations.
experiments.negative_expected_result: Raw TGI counts do not establish accepted-inference requests; L1-001 and L1-005 normalization remains unresolved.
experiments.positive_expected_result: Source-scoped success rate is (150-100)/10 = 5 requests/second; reset is identified without a negative rate.
experiments.purpose: Specify and later evaluate: Counter rates, resets and unresolved arrivals
experiments.title: Counter rates, resets and unresolved arrivals

experiments.input_specification: Aggregate timing histograms and separate success counts, with no joint per-request records or second moments.
experiments.limits_of_claim: This is a negative semantic experiment from the requirement baseline, not a newly supported per-request integration.
experiments.negative_expected_result: Exact joint goodput and exact variance return insufficient-input; no invented request events or exact values are emitted.
experiments.positive_expected_result: Retain and report the available aggregates with their source boundaries.
experiments.purpose: Specify and later evaluate: Insufficient aggregate evidence
experiments.title: Insufficient aggregate evidence

experiments.input_specification: Frontend and backend observations referring to the same ten logical requests; frontend also reports a worker whose location evidence is missing.
experiments.limits_of_claim: Logical overlap is supplied by invented linkage and is not inferred as a general live-engine capability.
experiments.negative_expected_result: Worker host is unknown, not the frontend host; timing distributions are not merged as interchangeable measurements.
experiments.positive_expected_result: An explicit source counting boundary reports ten logical requests, not twenty; each raw series retains its producer.
experiments.purpose: Specify and later evaluate: Framework/backend duplication and remote subject
experiments.title: Framework/backend duplication and remote subject

experiments.input_specification: Replica-wide count 100; two symbolic GPU models; used/total memory 10/20 and 20/40 in matching invented units.
experiments.limits_of_claim: Symbolic device inputs are baseline-only synthetic records, not captures or certified hardware schemas.
experiments.negative_expected_result: Missing total prevents occupancy; incomplete membership remains partial rather than a single verified GPU-model label.
experiments.positive_expected_result: Replica count remains 100, not 200; each device has occupancy 0.5; device membership is a set.
experiments.purpose: Specify and later evaluate: Replica GPU set and memory occupancy
experiments.title: Replica GPU set and memory occupancy

experiments.input_specification: Same invented PID with a new process-start identity; changed cgroup membership; denied runtime metadata.
experiments.limits_of_claim: Tests identity logic, not actual procfs/runtime discovery or backward compatibility.
experiments.negative_expected_result: No guessed container on denied metadata, and no historical relabeling through PID reuse.
experiments.positive_expected_result: Historical observations retain the old incarnation and membership; later observations use new evidence with validity windows.
experiments.purpose: Specify and later evaluate: Process and cgroup incarnation changes
experiments.title: Process and cgroup incarnation changes

experiments.input_specification: Symbolic multi-transport adapter, source-scoped interface byte counters and a configured preference; no payload-operation path record.
experiments.limits_of_claim: No real NIC model, fabric mode or hardware counter support is selected or proven.
experiments.negative_expected_result: Active transport and operation-to-NIC attribution remain unknown; no RoCE/InfiniBand/TCP conclusion from one control socket.
experiments.positive_expected_result: Preserve capability, configured preference and byte counters independently.
experiments.purpose: Specify and later evaluate: NIC capability is not observed transport
experiments.title: NIC capability is not observed transport

experiments.input_specification: Complete two-rank group arriving at 100 and 130 virtual microseconds in one declared clock domain; variants with missing member, mismatched group incarnation or unknown offset.
experiments.limits_of_claim: Tests arithmetic on invented events, not physical timing accuracy or an implemented collective collector.
experiments.negative_expected_result: Incomplete membership or uncertain cross-clock offsets prevent exact whole-group skew; bounded estimates must retain uncertainty.
experiments.positive_expected_result: Arrival skew is 30 virtual microseconds with complete membership and a stated clock/uncertainty model.
experiments.purpose: Specify and later evaluate: Distributed rank skew and clock uncertainty
experiments.title: Distributed rank skew and clock uncertainty

experiments.input_specification: In virtual microseconds, stream A covers [0,10] and [20,30]; B covers [10,20]; observation window [0,30].
experiments.limits_of_claim: Invented device events do not qualify a real profiling or microsecond acquisition path.
experiments.negative_expected_result: Missing stream coverage prevents a whole-device idle claim.
experiments.positive_expected_result: Stream A has a ten-microsecond gap while complete device coverage has zero idle time in the window.
experiments.purpose: Specify and later evaluate: Stream gap versus whole-device idle
experiments.title: Stream gap versus whole-device idle

experiments.input_specification: Two stable record IDs; interruptions before and after the declared simulated durability/commit boundary; pre-persistence volatile-loss variant.
experiments.limits_of_claim: Storage mechanics and durability are future local experiments; no production zero-loss or object-store guarantee.
experiments.negative_expected_result: Pre-persistence loss is explicitly accounted for; admitted is not durable and retries cannot multiply logical records.
experiments.positive_expected_result: Within the protected boundary, recovery yields exactly two unique committed records; query excludes uncommitted files.
experiments.purpose: Specify and later evaluate: Storage admission, commit and replay
experiments.title: Storage admission, commit and replay

experiments.input_specification: Invented denied source, disabled family, missing identity, sensitive labels and required-null acceptance limit; attempts at forbidden activation/escalation/workload mutation.
experiments.limits_of_claim: Planned policy assertions grant no real access and do not constitute an executed collector policy test.
experiments.negative_expected_result: Forbidden actions are rejected; required-null acceptance prevents readiness/pass rather than enabling telemetry automatically.
experiments.positive_expected_result: Keep denied, disabled and unknown states explicit; sanitize retained data; no secret values or private payloads.
experiments.purpose: Specify and later evaluate: Visibility, privacy and action policy
experiments.title: Visibility, privacy and action policy

experiments.input_specification: Two equal latest iteration-gauge snapshots; separate pipeline assertion with queue capacity two records and three offered stable IDs under reject-new policy.
experiments.limits_of_claim: Queue count and virtual times are fixture values, not throughput, physical resolution or production loss promises.
experiments.negative_expected_result: No inference of absent intervening updates, complete iteration coverage or lossless delivery of all three records.
experiments.positive_expected_result: State source freshness uncertainty; the pipeline assertion admits two and explicitly rejects one.
experiments.purpose: Specify and later evaluate: Latest-gauge freshness and bounded admission
experiments.title: Latest-gauge freshness and bounded admission
